nodes.name: reference-board.md
nodes.summary: Design reference board for the app-shell navigation, capturing CoreUI and Duolingo patterns used plus anti-references and a clinic-notice-board direction contract.

nodes.name: style-lock.md
nodes.summary: Locked visual style contract for Avsar: Bricolage/Inter/DM Mono type split, warm-paper herb-green palette, shape rules, dark-mode mapping, and leaf-mark identity motif.

nodes.name: manifest.webmanifest
nodes.summary: PWA manifest naming Avsar as a BAMS internship tracker with standalone display, portrait orientation, warm-paper theme color, and an SVG favicon icon.

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.summary: Zero-dependency service worker caching the app shell on install and serving same-origin GETs stale-while-revalidate so the demo works offline.
nodes.languageNotes: Cache-first with background revalidation for same-origin GETs; cross-origin API and font requests pass through untouched.

nodes.name: naukri.mjs
nodes.summary: Dependency-free Node importer mapping scraped Naukri JSON into app job seeds with denylist filtering, track hints, skill extraction, and title+company dedup.

nodes.name: mapNaukri
nodes.summary: Maps one raw Naukri posting to the app job shape, rejecting denylisted titles and inferring track, skills, location, and fresher score.

nodes.name: importNaukri
nodes.summary: Runs mapNaukri over a raw jobs payload, deduping by title+company and reporting jobs, dropped, and total counts.

nodes.name: scrape.mjs
nodes.summary: Terminal-initiated keyless job scraper hitting Remotive and Arbeitnow JSON APIs and writing a dated markdown shortlist under .scratch/.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses global fetch with AbortSignal.timeout and top-level await; no headless browser or HTML parsing beyond tag stripping.

nodes.name: boardsSeed.js
nodes.summary: Large BOARDS_JOBS seed dataset backing the jobs board with pre-shaped listings consumed by the store layer.

nodes.name: fixtures.js
nodes.summary: Minimal SAMPLE_RESUME fixture used by tests and resume flows as a canonical example resume.

nodes.name: naukriSeed.js
nodes.summary: NAUKRI_JOBS seed dataset of normalized Naukri postings generated by the naukri importer script.

nodes.name: seedJobsExtra.js
nodes.summary: Small EXTRA_JOBS seed extension adding extra listings on top of the main jobs datasets.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global Tailwind v4 stylesheet defining theme fonts, dark zinc system palette, and shared keyframes and utilities like cursor blink and notice ticker.

nodes.name: ayushProof.test.js
nodes.summary: Node test suite for the AYUSH proof ledger and scoring overlay covering case-log accumulation, mentor verification, confidence caps, and vaidya levels.

nodes.name: naukri.test.js
nodes.summary: Node test suite for the Naukri importer covering skill mapping, title denylisting, and title+company dedup counting.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration wiring the React and Tailwind v4 plugins for the app.
